criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Greetings and Social Pleasantries
categories.definition: Utterances used to greet the bot, check its presence, or ask how it is doing.

categories.name: Gratitude and Feedback
categories.definition: Expressions of thanks, appreciation, or positive feedback regarding the bot's service.

categories.name: General Information and Definition
categories.definition: Requests for a summary, definition, or general explanation of COVID-19 and how it works.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Questions regarding specific symptoms, signs of infection, or how to identify the disease in oneself or others.

categories.name: Transmission and Surface Survival
categories.definition: Questions about how the virus spreads, survival time on surfaces, and transmission modes like air or objects.

categories.name: Prevention and Safety Precautions
categories.definition: Requests for advice on protective measures, hygiene practices, and safety protocols to avoid infection.

categories.name: Treatments and Cures
categories.definition: Questions about medical treatments, drugs, remedies, or potential cures for COVID-19.

categories.name: Vaccines
categories.definition: Questions specifically concerning the existence, availability, or development of a COVID-19 vaccine.

categories.name: Statistics and Case Counts
categories.definition: Requests for specific numbers regarding cases, deaths, tests, or recovery rates in specific locations.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news, recent updates, or general status reports on the pandemic situation.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Questions asking to verify, debunk, or list myths and misinformation regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Animals and Pets
categories.definition: Questions regarding the transmission, symptoms, or risks of COVID-19 specifically for animals or pets.

categories.name: Travel and Transport
categories.definition: Questions about travel restrictions, flight cancellations, border closures, and the safety of transportation methods.

categories.name: High Risk Areas and Groups
categories.definition: Questions identifying high risk locations or asking for advice relevant to high risk groups.

categories.name: Donations and Charitable Support
categories.definition: Intent to donate money or goods, or requests for information on how to support relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing and Invitations
categories.definition: Requests to share the bot, a specific link, or information with friends, family, or social media.
